name: Ayato Yuu
source:
The main character of the story. A third-year student at the school.

Currently ranked E (lowest rank).

He is very kind-hearted and straightforward, to the point of being naiive; He doesn't know how to question or doubt others.

He can't stand to see someone in trouble, so he often goes out of his way to help them, against the expectations of others, resulting in him being late and points being deducted from his grades.

Despite his shortcomings, however, he works hard every day to graduate.

[Translated from [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/hoken/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
